notes: Example add-on: one company listed on the Lodestar Exchange, in an existing sector, following ore at Zhonghuamen Terminal, with one piece of story news that moves its price when the story flag is set, and a history before the game: founded in 2052, listed in 2058 at 4 credits a share, a lore entry and one event that shapes its price history.

keelhaul-freight.name: Keelhaul Freight
keelhaul-freight.profile: Bulk freight line running ore and plate between the belt markets and Port Yangshan. Its holds fill when ore runs short at Zhonghuamen Terminal.

keelhaul-first-hull.line: Founded with one secondhand bulk hauler working the belt runs out of Zhonghuamen Terminal.

keelhaul-ceres-route.line: Wins the Ceres ore route when its rival loses two haulers to a debris field.

news.wire: Keelhaul Freight wins the Cassini Spaceport ore contract for the coming season.
